items.quote: PATs are generated in the developer console.
You can generate a personal access token from the Asana developer console.
The Asana API is a RESTful interface with predictable resource-oriented URLs, accepts JSON or form-encoded requests, returns JSON, and uses standard HTTP features.
Official Asana MCP server (V2) at https://mcp.asana.com/v2/mcp, requiring OAuth 2.0 authentication with a registered client ID and client secret

mcp_probe.www_authenticate: Bearer realm="Asana MCP", resource_metadata="https://mcp.asana.com/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/v2", error="invalid_request", error_description="Authorization header is required for MCP V2 access"
mcp_probe.body: {"error":"invalid_request","error_description":"Authorization header is required for MCP V2 access"}
